title: Hearty Egyptian Chickpeas Stew
description: A savory, one-pot Egyptian chickpea stew infused with orange juice and a fragrant bhuna of spices, cooked on a cedar plank for a subtle smoky aroma.
instructions: Soak a cedar plank in warm water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Heat the olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat and add the cumin seeds, coriander, and turmeric; toast until fragrant, about 1 minute (bhuna).
Add the diced onion and garlic to the skillet and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the diced carrots and tomatoes and cook until the vegetables begin to soften, about 4 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and orange juice, and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add the cooked chickpeas, salt and pepper to taste, and stir well.
Place the cedar plank in the skillet and pour the stew over it, covering the plank with a lid to trap steam.
Simmer the stew on low heat until thickened and flavors meld, about 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the cedar plank carefully, then transfer the stew to a serving bowl.
Garnish with fresh parsley if desired, and serve hot.
